record_title: Kernel-wreath abelianization order and the exterior-square correction
provenance: A group-homological analysis of the multiplicative kernel in the kernel-wreath construction of arXiv:2609.20401v1, using coordinatewise abelianization, coinvariants, Shapiro's lemma, and the alternating part of the tensor square of the abelian target.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Standard full-wreath-product abelianization and standard group-homology tools are prior work. Older wreath-product or group-extension literature was not exhaustively inspected theorem-by-theorem, so an equivalent augmentation-kernel formula under different terminology remains a residual originality risk. The theorem determines the order of the abelianization, not its invariant-factor decomposition, and the natural extension over the old abelianization need not split. No independent validation is asserted.
